fact: Bill n°21/2026 would amend article 3 of law n°2016-09 of 14 March 2016, which instituted the ECOWAS biometric identity card, to allow an exceptional extension of the card's 10-year validity in case of force majeure; the Commission des Lois examined it (September 2026).
title: Projet de loi n°21/2026 - Rapport Commission - modification carte d'identité biométrique CEDEAO
